overview: Based on the published agenda, this Committee of the Whole meeting was scheduled to address the 2027-28 school calendar and the Wisconsin Seal of Biliteracy program through a Policy 2370 update. The board was expected to consider approval of both items, alongside routine business including minute approval and bill audit.

agenda.item: Policy 2370 - Educational Opportunities (Wisconsin Seal of Biliteracy) (Action Requested)

discussions.body: The agenda included a presentation highlighting excellence and achievements at Wausau East High School, though specific details about the focus or content were not provided in the published materials.

Diana White, Communications Coordinator, and Dr. Katie Colwell, Assistant Superintendent of Academics, were scheduled to present the proposed school calendar for 2027-2028 with an estimated presentation time of 10 minutes. The presentation included draft calendar materials and supporting documentation.

discussions.item: Policy 2370 - Educational Opportunities (Wisconsin Seal of Biliteracy) (Action Requested)
discussions.body: The board was scheduled to receive a 10-minute presentation regarding the Wisconsin Seal of Biliteracy program and was expected to consider updating Policy 2370 to formally recognize it as an educational opportunity offered in the district. Supporting materials included policy documentation and a presentation on the Seal of Biliteracy.

publicComment: Public and Student Comment was included on this agenda.
actionItems: Board was expected to vote on approval of the 2027-28 school calendar as presented by Diana White and Dr. Katie Colwell
Board was expected to vote on updating Policy 2370 to recognize the Wisconsin Seal of Biliteracy as an educational opportunity in the district
title: Committee of the Whole Meeting - 2026-09-28
